title: chore(deps): exempt GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 (@azure/msal-node via tedious) until 2026-11-26
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WV2t4SJjcpQk4Wkqfp7kPN)_

Fixes #26428

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 `osv-scanner.toml` 加一条豁免，`GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5`，`ignoreUntil = 2026-11-26`（30 天）。只改这一个文件。
- 为什么改：定时 OSV 扫描从 10-21 起每天红，唯一的发现就是这条：`@azure/msal-node` 5.4.1，High。修复版是 7.1.0，但目前没有任何已发布的 `@azure/identity` 接受 msal-node 7（最新的 4.14.0 仍要求 `^6`），所以拿不到修复版。
- 风险：只出现在开发依赖树里，路径是 tedious（driver-sql 的可选 mssql peer）→ `@azure/identity` → msal-node，不进任何发布包。漏洞在授权码流程（`acquireTokenByCode`），tedious 不调用它。
- 回滚：revert 即可。到 11-26 豁免自动失效，扫描会重新报红。

## What changes

One `[[IgnoredVulns]]` entry in `osv-scanner.toml`. This PR carries no other change, per convention 3 (an exemption lands in its own PR, labelled `osv-exemption`).

## Why

**What the scan shows.** Scheduled run 40442115529 (2026-10-27 03:05Z), OSV-Scanner v2.5.0 on `pnpm-lock.yaml`:

```
| https://osv.dev/GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 | 7.5 | npm | @azure/msal-node | 5.4.1 | 7.1.0 | pnpm-lock.yaml |
```

**The advisory** (osv.dev): "MSAL Node authorization code flow may disclose parameters to an attacker-controlled endpoint", CWE-346. Affected from `5.0.0-beta.0` to before `7.1.0`. The workaround it names is passing only the auth code to `acquireTokenByCode`.

**Why no fix can be taken today.**
- The path in the lockfile is `tedious@18.6.2` → `@azure/identity@4.13.1` → `@azure/msal-node@5.4.1`. tedious is `driver-sql`'s optional `peerDependency`, so this repo installs it for its own tree and no published package carries it.
- `npm view @azure/identity@4.14.0 dependencies.@azure/msal-node` gives `^6.0.0`, and every 6.x is inside the affected range. tedious 20.3.8, its latest, needs `@azure/identity ^4.13.1`.
- The only way to reach 7.1.0 would be a pnpm override that forces msal-node a major past the range `@azure/identity` declares. This PR does not do that.

**When to remove it.** Once a published `@azure/identity` accepts msal-node `>=7.1.0` and tedious resolves to it, bump instead and delete this entry. The 30-day `ignoreUntil` forces this decision to be looked at again.

## Also reported by the same scan, not changed here

The scanner reports the existing `GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c` entry (sprintf-js, `ignoreUntil = 2026-11-05`) as an **unused ignore**. osv.dev shows that advisory **withdrawn on 2026-10-22**, so the entry no longer matches anything, though `sprintf-js` 1.0.3 and 1.1.3 are still in the lockfile. It is left alone here: one exemption change per PR. It can be removed in its own PR, or it will drop out on its own date.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs --self-test`: passes.
- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs`: `✓ 2 OSV exemption(s) in osv-scanner.toml: all carry an unexpired ignoreUntil within 90 days and a reason with an advisory link.`
- OSV-Scanner itself is not run locally (its container image is not reachable from this session). This PR's `Validate Dependencies` run (triggered by `osv-scanner.toml`) is the measurement.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
